title.zh-CN: 上腹胀痛、恶心呕吐 · 58岁女性
title.en: Upper abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting · 58-year-old woman

summary.zh-CN: 一位58岁女性因上腹胀痛和呕吐住院：处理这次发作，查找发作的原因，再沿着她此后的记录病程复盘。
summary.en: A 58-year-old woman is admitted with upper abdominal pain and vomiting: treat the attack, look for what caused it, and follow her recorded course.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按现行标准处理急性胰腺炎的最初几天——乳酸钠林格液目标导向适度补液、尽早低脂经口饮食、不预防性使用抗菌药物、仅在胆管炎时行 ERCP——并与禁食加抗菌药物的旧做法对照（ACG 2024）。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage the first days of acute pancreatitis to the current standard — lactated Ringer's at a moderate, goal-directed rate, early low-fat oral feeding, no prophylactic antibiotics, ERCP only for cholangitis — and contrast it with fasting and antibiotics (ACG 2024).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 对每一次胰腺炎发作做病因筛查，把发作期的血钙升高识别为危险信号：复查白蛋白校正钙并同步测 PTH（IAP/APA 2013；NICE NG132，2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Screen every attack of pancreatitis for its cause, and treat a raised calcium during an attack as a red flag that needs a repeat albumin-adjusted calcium with a paired PTH (IAP/APA 2013; NICE NG132, 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在任何定位影像之前用生化检查确立原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症，并说明影像为何既不能确诊也不能排除它（第五届原发性甲旁亢国际研讨会，2022）。
learningOutcomes.en: Establish primary hyperparathyroidism biochemically before any localisation scan, and explain why imaging can neither make nor exclude the diagnosis (Fifth International Workshop on primary hyperparathyroidism, 2022).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 遇到检验项目名称存疑的结果（此处标为“甲状腺素”的 31 pmol/L），先与检验科核实或复查，再让它影响手术等决定。
learningOutcomes.en: Resolve a result whose analyte label is in doubt (here 31 pmol/L labelled 'thyroxine') with the laboratory, or repeat it, before it carries a decision such as an operation.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把伴肾结石和反复胰腺炎的原发性甲旁亢转诊给有经验的甲状旁腺外科医生，并说明为何西那卡塞或细针穿刺不是下一步（AAES 2016；NICE NG132，2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Refer primary hyperparathyroidism with kidney stones and recurrent pancreatitis to an experienced parathyroid surgeon, and explain why cinacalcet or a needle biopsy is not the next step (AAES 2016; NICE NG132, 2019).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 评估甲状旁腺术后的肢体麻木：复查校正钙或离子钙并查体，只按急诊阈值静脉补钙，术后 3–6 个月复查血钙确认治愈（英国内分泌学会 2016；NICE NG132，2019）。
learningOutcomes.en: Assess numbness after parathyroid surgery with an adjusted or ionised calcium and an examination, give IV calcium gluconate only by the emergency thresholds, and confirm cure with a calcium 3–6 months later (Society for Endocrinology 2016; NICE NG132, 2019).

notes.zh-CN: 依据单篇已发表病例报告改编。本版（1.1.0）的患者事实全部沿用 1.0.0 版从报告中提取的内容——58岁女性；第一次发作（上腹持续胀痛伴恶心、呕吐 1 天；左上腹及脐周压痛、局部轻度肌紧张、反跳痛可疑、墨菲征阴性、颈部未触及包块；淀粉酶 1139 U/L、血钙 2.76 mmol/L；CT 示胰腺炎及左肾结石）；出院后无症状、未服降压药时血压正常；约 20 个月后再次发作（突发上腹胀痛伴恶心、呕吐，8 小时后就诊；淀粉酶 1055.9 U/L、血钙 2.87 mmol/L；CT 仍见胰腺炎及肾结石）；颈部超声及 CT 示左甲状腺下极后方病灶；切除约 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm，病理为甲状旁腺腺瘤；术前一项 31 pmol/L 的结果被标为“甲状腺素”（可能为误标的 PTH）；术后 PTH 3.8 pmol/L、血钙 2.18 mmol/L 并维持正常，曾短暂四肢麻木、无抽搐、自行缓解；随访未诉不适（时长未记录）；报告的胰腺炎处置包括禁食和抗菌药物——尚未对照原文全文核对。患者为化名，医院和日历日期已去除，时间以相对时间表示。分阶段、决策、处置选项、评分、医护角色和患者说出的担忧（教学设定，不增加临床事实）均为教学设计；未记录的内容（生命体征、病情严重程度、白蛋白与离子钙、胆囊影像、甘油三酯、参考区间、手术细节、随访时长）保持未知。保留的内部不一致：术前激素结果的项目名称（甲状腺素或 PTH）不作裁定，两种读法并列；第二次 CT 的结石侧别和数目没有写明。原报告图片因带有日期信息未获准展示。
notes.en: Adapted from a single published case report. Every patient fact in this version (1.1.0) is one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0 — a 58-year-old woman; the first attack (a day of constant upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting; tenderness in the left upper quadrant and around the umbilicus with mild local guarding, equivocal rebound, negative Murphy's sign, no palpable neck mass; amylase 1139 U/L, calcium 2.76 mmol/L; CT pancreatitis and a left renal stone); no symptoms after discharge and a normal blood pressure off antihypertensives; a second attack about 20 months later (sudden upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting, presenting after 8 hours; amylase 1055.9 U/L, calcium 2.87 mmol/L; CT pancreatitis with renal stone(s) still seen); neck ultrasound/CT showing a lesion behind the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe; its removal (about 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm) with a histology of parathyroid adenoma; a pre-operative value of 31 pmol/L labelled 'thyroxine' (possibly a mislabelled PTH); post-operative PTH 3.8 pmol/L and calcium 2.18 mmol/L, staying normal, with transient limb numbness without tetany that settled on its own; no complaints at follow-up (length not recorded); and the report's care of the pancreatitis with fasting and antibiotics — and none has yet been checked against the full article. The patient has a pseudonym; hospitals and calendar dates are removed and time is relative. The phases, decisions, intervention options, scoring, staff and the patient's voiced worry (a teaching device that adds no clinical fact) are teaching design; what is not recorded (vital signs, severity, albumin and ionised calcium, gallbladder imaging, triglycerides, reference intervals, operative details, length of follow-up) stays unknown. Kept as recorded, not resolved: the analyte of the pre-operative hormone value (thyroxine or PTH) — both readings stand; the side and number of the stones on the second CT are not stated. The report's figure is withheld because it carries date information.

guidelines: Fifth International Workshop on Primary Hyperparathyroidism 2022 (J Bone Miner Res)
Society for Endocrinology 2016 emergency guidance: acute hypocalcaemia in adults

actingNotes.zh-CN: 扮演者：只演当前阶段，不提任何后来的事。第一次住院：躺在病床上，上腹胀痛、恶心，难受又着急。再次入院：又痛起来，失望地说“怎么又犯了”。手术之后：能平静交谈，只诉胳膊和腿发麻、没有抽搐。随访：状态良好。只回答被问到的内容；不提化验、影像或任何数字，不编造病史、用药、饮酒或过敏。
actingNotes.en: For the actor: play only the current phase and never mention anything that comes later. First admission: lying in bed with a bloated upper abdominal pain and nausea, uncomfortable and anxious. Readmission: in pain again and dismayed that it has come back. After the operation: talks calmly, mentioning only that her arms and legs feel numb and that she has had no spasms. Follow-up: well. She answers only what she is asked, never mentions tests, scans or numbers, and never invents history, medicines, alcohol or allergies.

description.zh-CN: 她因上腹持续胀痛伴恶心、呕吐 1 天收入病房：采集病史、查体、看结果，处理这次发作，并在出院前想清楚它的原因。
description.en: She is admitted after a day of constant upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting: take the history, examine her, read the results, treat the attack and, before she goes home, think through its cause.

text.zh-CN: 记录的病程：58岁女性，上腹持续胀痛伴恶心、呕吐 1 天入院。查体：左上腹及脐周压痛，局部轻度肌紧张，反跳痛可疑，墨菲征阴性，颈部未触及包块。血清淀粉酶 1139 U/L，血钙 2.76 mmol/L；CT 示胰腺炎及左肾结石。出院后饮食、大便正常，无腹痛腹胀，无骨痛及腰背酸痛，无多尿多饮，未服降压药时血压亦正常。约 20 个月后再次突发上腹胀痛伴恶心、呕吐，8 小时后就诊：淀粉酶 1055.9 U/L，血钙 2.87 mmol/L；CT 仍见胰腺炎及肾结石。颈部超声、CT 示左侧甲状腺下极后方病灶。报告中一项术前激素结果 31 pmol/L 标为“甲状腺素”（可能为误标的 PTH）。切除的病灶约 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm，病理为甲状旁腺腺瘤。术后 PTH（明确标注）降至 3.8 pmol/L、血钙降至 2.18 mmol/L，此后均维持正常；曾短暂四肢麻木，无抽搐，后自行缓解。随访未诉不适，随访时长未记录。报告对胰腺炎的处置包括禁食和抗菌药物；具体药物、剂量、疗程及用于哪一次发作，本病例没有记录。生命体征、病情严重程度、白蛋白、离子钙、胆囊影像、手术细节和各项参考区间均无记录。
text.en: Recorded course: a 58-year-old woman was admitted after a day of constant upper abdominal pain with nausea and vomiting. Examination: tenderness in the left upper quadrant and around the umbilicus with mild local guarding, equivocal rebound, negative Murphy's sign, no palpable neck mass. Amylase 1139 U/L, calcium 2.76 mmol/L; CT: pancreatitis and a left renal stone. After discharge she ate normally with normal bowels, had no abdominal pain or bloating, no bone or back ache and no polyuria or polydipsia, and her blood pressure was normal without antihypertensive medicine. About 20 months later the pain returned suddenly with nausea and vomiting and she came in after 8 hours: amylase 1055.9 U/L, calcium 2.87 mmol/L; CT: pancreatitis with renal stone(s) still seen. Neck ultrasound/CT: a lesion behind the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe. A pre-operative hormone value of 31 pmol/L is labelled 'thyroxine' in the report (possibly a mislabelled PTH). The lesion, about 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm, was removed; histology: parathyroid adenoma. Afterwards the PTH (explicitly labelled) fell to 3.8 pmol/L and the calcium to 2.18 mmol/L, and both stayed normal; she had transient numbness of the limbs without tetany, which settled on its own. At follow-up she had no complaints; its length is not recorded. The report's care of the pancreatitis included fasting and antibiotics; this case does not record the agents, doses, duration or which attack they were given for. No vital signs, severity, albumin, ionised calcium, gallbladder imaging, operative details or reference intervals are recorded.

name.en: Insert an IV cannula and take blood

dose.zh-CN: 外周静脉留置针，同时抽取血标本送检。
dose.en: Peripheral IV cannula, with blood samples taken at the same time.

response.zh-CN: 留置针已置入，血标本已送检。本病例没有记录是否做过这一步；不模拟其效果。
response.en: The cannula is in and the samples have gone. This case does not record whether this was done; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 乳酸钠林格液目标导向适度补液
name.en: Goal-directed lactated Ringer's at a moderate rate

dose.zh-CN: 乳酸钠林格液 1.5 mL/(kg·h)，有低血容量表现时追加 10 mL/kg；按心率、血压和尿量反复评估并调整，避免液体过多。
dose.en: Lactated Ringer's at 1.5 mL/kg/h, with a 10 mL/kg bolus only if she is hypovolaemic; reassess pulse, blood pressure and urine output and adjust, avoiding overload.

response.zh-CN: 补液已开始。本病例没有记录她用了哪种液体、速度和总量；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Fluids are running. This case does not record which fluid she received, at what rate or how much; it does not simulate the effect.

name.en: Analgesia titrated to her pain score

dose.zh-CN: 按疼痛评分给药：对乙酰氨基酚静脉或口服；肾功能允许时可用非甾体抗炎药；剧痛时静脉滴定阿片类药物，并观察镇静程度和呼吸。
dose.en: By pain score: paracetamol IV or by mouth; an NSAID if renal function allows; an IV opioid titrated for severe pain, watching sedation and breathing.

response.zh-CN: 已给镇痛。本病例没有记录用了什么止痛药；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Analgesia given. This case does not record which analgesic was used; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 尽早经口进食（低脂饮食）
name.en: Early oral feeding with a low-fat diet

dose.zh-CN: 能耐受就开始低脂软食或普通低脂饮食（轻症通常在 24–48 小时内），不必等淀粉酶恢复正常；经口进食失败的重症改用肠内营养。
dose.en: Start a low-fat soft or normal diet as soon as she tolerates it (in mild disease usually within 24–48 hours), without waiting for the amylase to normalise; tube feeding if oral intake fails in severe disease.

response.zh-CN: 已安排进食。本病例没有记录她何时恢复进食；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Feeding arranged. This case does not record when she started eating; it does not simulate the effect.

name.zh-CN: 禁食，直到淀粉酶恢复正常
name.en: Nil by mouth until the amylase is normal

dose.zh-CN: 完全禁食，待淀粉酶恢复正常后再逐步进食。
dose.en: No food at all until the amylase is back to normal, then a gradual return to eating.

harm.zh-CN: ACG 2024 指南建议轻症急性胰腺炎在 24–48 小时内开始低脂经口饮食，而不是禁食到酶学恢复正常；长时间禁食没有证实的好处。
harm.en: ACG 2024 recommends a low-fat oral diet within 24–48 hours in mild acute pancreatitis rather than fasting until the enzymes normalise; prolonged fasting has no proven benefit.

response.zh-CN: 本病例记录的历史处置中包括禁食（时长未记录）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The report's historical care included fasting (for how long is not recorded); this case does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 预防性静脉抗菌药物（如碳青霉烯类）

dose.zh-CN: 例如亚胺培南或美罗培南静脉给药，用于预防胰腺坏死感染。
dose.en: For example IV imipenem or meropenem, to prevent infection of pancreatic necrosis.

harm.zh-CN: 没有感染证据时不应预防性使用抗菌药物：ACG 2024 指南即使在重症急性胰腺炎中也不建议预防用药，因为没有证实的获益，却有耐药和不良反应的风险。本病例没有任何感染证据的记录。
harm.en: Without evidence of infection, antibiotics are not given as prophylaxis: ACG 2024 advises against them even in severe acute pancreatitis — no proven benefit, and the risks of resistance and adverse effects. Nothing in this case records an infection.

response.zh-CN: 本病例记录的历史处置中包括抗菌药物（药物、剂量未记录）；本病例不模拟其效果。
response.en: The report's historical care included antibiotics (agents and doses not recorded); this case does not simulate their effect.

name.zh-CN: 大量快速补液（20 mL/kg 快速输注后 3 mL/(kg·h)）
name.en: Aggressive fluids (20 mL/kg bolus, then 3 mL/kg/h)

dose.zh-CN: 林格液 20 mL/kg 快速输注，此后 3 mL/(kg·h)，第一天不论反应如何都维持。
dose.en: Ringer's 20 mL/kg as a bolus, then 3 mL/kg/h, kept up for the first day whatever her response.

harm.zh-CN: WATERFALL 试验（NEJM 2022）中正是这一方案，比适度补液导致更多液体过负荷却没有改善结局，试验因此提前终止；ACG 2024 指南建议适度、目标导向的补液。
harm.en: In the WATERFALL trial (NEJM 2022) this regimen caused more fluid overload than moderate resuscitation without better outcomes, and the trial was stopped early; ACG 2024 suggests moderate, goal-directed fluids.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录这样的补液方案；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no such fluid regimen; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 经内镜逆行胰胆管造影，必要时乳头括约肌切开取石。
dose.en: Endoscopic retrograde cholangiopancreatography, with sphincterotomy and stone extraction if needed.

harm.zh-CN: 没有胆管炎的急性胰腺炎首选内科治疗，而不是早期 ERCP（ACG 2024）。本病例没有任何指向胆管的记录（没有黄疸、胆红素或胆管表现的记录），而 ERCP 本身可引起胰腺炎、出血和穿孔，可能危及生命，病因却仍然没有找到。
harm.en: In acute pancreatitis without cholangitis, medical therapy is preferred to early ERCP (ACG 2024). Nothing recorded in this case points to the bile duct (no jaundice, bilirubin or duct finding is recorded), while ERCP itself can cause pancreatitis, bleeding and perforation, which can be life-threatening — and the cause would still be unfound.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录 ERCP；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no ERCP; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 出院前预约好她的结果所需要的复查（待这次发作缓解后进行），并安排门诊查看结果。
dose.en: Before she goes home, book the repeat tests her results call for, once the attack has settled, and a clinic review of them.

response.zh-CN: 随访已安排。本病例没有记录这次出院后是否做过复查；接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Follow-up arranged. This case does not record whether any repeat tests were done after this discharge; the records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 常规出院，不安排进一步检查
name.en: Routine discharge with no further tests

dose.zh-CN: 能进食、腹痛缓解后出院，不安排复查。
dose.en: Home once she is eating and the pain has settled, with nothing further planned.

harm.zh-CN: 每一次首发的胰腺炎都要查找病因（IAP/APA 2013）；发作期血钙升高尤其不寻常，NICE NG132（2019）要求复查并同步测 PTH。什么都不安排就出院，这次发作中没有解释的结果就没人追查，病因可能一直留着。
harm.en: Every first attack of pancreatitis needs its cause sought (IAP/APA 2013), and a raised calcium during an attack is unusual enough that NICE NG132 (2019) asks for a repeat with a paired PTH. Discharging her with nothing planned leaves any unexplained result of this attack unanswered, and the cause in place.

response.zh-CN: 她出院回家，没有安排进一步检查。接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: She goes home with nothing further planned. The records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 向检验科核实存疑结果并复查
name.en: Query a doubtful result with the laboratory and repeat it

dose.zh-CN: 请检验科确认存疑结果实际测的是哪一项，并按需要同步采集配对标本复查。
dose.en: Ask the laboratory to confirm what a doubtful result actually measured, and repeat it with the paired samples it needs.

response.zh-CN: 已联系检验科并送检复查。本病例没有记录核实或复查的结果；不模拟新的结果。
response.en: The laboratory has been asked and a repeat sample sent. This case records no answer and no repeat result; it does not simulate a new result.

name.zh-CN: 转诊有经验的内分泌外科医生
name.en: Refer to an experienced endocrine surgeon

dose.zh-CN: 转诊每年做大量此类手术的外科医生，带上生化结果和定位影像。
dose.en: Refer to a surgeon who does many of these operations each year, with the blood results and the localisation imaging.

harm.zh-CN: 手术必须以确定的生化诊断为前提：血钙升高，同时 PTH 升高或与血钙不相称地正常，两者同步测定（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）。任何存疑的激素结果都要先与检验科核实；如果 PTH 实际偏低，NICE NG132 要求寻找包括恶性肿瘤在内的其他病因。
harm.en: An operation rests on a confirmed biochemical diagnosis: a raised calcium with a raised or inappropriately normal PTH, measured together (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019). Any doubtful hormone result is settled with the laboratory first; if the PTH proved low, NICE NG132 sends you looking for another cause, including malignancy.

response.zh-CN: 外科已接到转诊。接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: The surgeons have the referral. The records that follow show the course as it happened.

name.zh-CN: 超声引导下细针穿刺病灶
name.en: Ultrasound-guided fine-needle biopsy of a lesion

dose.zh-CN: 超声引导下细针穿刺病灶做细胞学检查。
dose.en: Fine-needle aspiration of the lesion under ultrasound for cytology.

harm.zh-CN: 穿刺不是这里的诊断步骤：诊断依靠血液生化（第五届国际研讨会，2022）。对甲状腺旁的病灶穿刺可能出血、造成粘连并使病灶组织种植扩散，细胞学结果也常常不确定；只在少数诊断不清的病例中选择性使用。
harm.en: A needle biopsy is not the diagnostic step here — the diagnosis is made in the blood (Fifth International Workshop 2022) — and biopsying a lesion beside the thyroid risks bleeding, scarring and seeding of its tissue, with cytology that is often inconclusive; it is kept for selected, unclear cases.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录穿刺；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no biopsy; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 西那卡塞口服，按血钙调整剂量；定期复查。
dose.en: Oral cinacalcet, dose adjusted to the calcium; regular checks.

harm.zh-CN: 西那卡塞能降低升高的血钙，但不能去除病因，只用于不能或不愿接受根治手术的患者；肾结石或胰腺炎这类并发症本身就是根治手术的指征（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）。
harm.en: Cinacalcet lowers a raised calcium but removes no cause; it is for people who cannot or will not have the definitive operation, and complications such as kidney stones or pancreatitis are themselves an indication for that operation (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019).

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录西那卡塞；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no cinacalcet; it does not simulate its effect.

name.zh-CN: 持续静脉滴注葡萄糖酸钙

dose.zh-CN: 10% 葡萄糖酸钙 100 mL 加入 0.9% 氯化钠或 5% 葡萄糖 1 L，50–100 mL/h 持续滴注。
dose.en: 10 % calcium gluconate 100 mL in 1 L of 0.9 % saline or 5 % glucose at 50–100 mL/h.

harm.zh-CN: 英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）只在校正钙低于 1.9 mmol/L、或钙低于参考区间且有症状时静脉补钙（10% 葡萄糖酸钙 10–20 mL 加入 5% 葡萄糖 50–100 mL，10 分钟内推注，心电监护下，之后视情况持续滴注）。她的记录中没有达到这一标准的结果：应先复查校正钙或离子钙；血钙升高时补钙更是有害。
harm.en: Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance (2016) keeps IV calcium for an adjusted calcium below 1.9 mmol/L, or for symptoms with a calcium below the reference range (10–20 mL of 10 % calcium gluconate in 50–100 mL of 5 % glucose over 10 minutes with ECG monitoring, then an infusion if needed). Nothing in her record meets that threshold: recheck an adjusted or ionised calcium first — and while the calcium is raised, giving calcium is harmful.

response.zh-CN: 本病例没有记录静脉补钙；不模拟其效果。
response.en: This case records no IV calcium; it does not simulate its effect.

dose.zh-CN: 症状轻时口服钙剂（如碳酸钙），按复查的校正钙调整。
dose.en: Oral calcium (e.g. calcium carbonate) for mild symptoms, adjusted to the repeat adjusted calcium.

harm.zh-CN: 血钙升高或原因未明时不补钙：补钙只会让升高的血钙更高。
harm.en: Calcium is not given while the calcium is raised or unexplained: a supplement would push a raised calcium higher.

response.zh-CN: 已给口服钙剂。本病例没有记录补钙；不模拟其效果。
response.en: Oral calcium given. This case records no calcium supplement; it does not simulate the effect.

dose.zh-CN: 出院前安排随访：确认治疗效果所需的血液复查及其时间，以及其他已发现问题的随访。
dose.en: Before discharge, book the follow-up she needs: the blood tests that confirm the result of treatment, with their timing, and follow-up of any other problem found.

response.zh-CN: 随访已安排。接下来的记录按实际病程展开。
response.en: Follow-up arranged. The records that follow show the course as it happened.

title.en: Take the history of this attack

hint.zh-CN: 这次痛是什么时候开始的、是什么样的痛、还伴有什么？哪些常见病因单靠问病史就能先问到？
hint.en: When did this pain start, what is it like and what comes with it — and which common causes can the history alone begin to point to?

guidance.zh-CN: 到床旁问清这次腹痛的起病、性质和伴随症状，以及饮酒和平时用药。
guidance.en: At the bedside, ask about the onset and nature of the pain, what comes with it, alcohol and her regular medicines.

title.zh-CN: 查体、看结果，定下这几天的处理
title.en: Examine her, read the results and set her care

hint.zh-CN: 查体能告诉你什么？哪几项结果已经足够诊断？这几天的治疗需要什么、不需要什么？
hint.en: What does the examination add, which results are enough for the diagnosis, and what do her first days of treatment need — and not need?

guidance.zh-CN: 给她查体，查看本次住院的淀粉酶、血钙和 CT 报告，然后在会诊板上定下最初几天的处理。
guidance.en: Examine her, read this admission's amylase, calcium and CT report, then set her first days of care on the case board.

title.en: Think through the cause before she goes home

hint.zh-CN: 这次发作的结果里，有没有哪一项是胰腺炎本身解释不了的？她离院之前要为它做些什么？
hint.en: Is there a result from this attack that the pancreatitis itself does not explain — and what must happen about it before she leaves?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上解释这次的结果，然后决定她出院前要安排什么。
guidance.en: Interpret this attack's results on the case board, then decide what to arrange before she goes home.

hint.zh-CN: 两次发作之间她过得怎么样？这一次的结果和上一次比，有哪些是一样的？
hint.en: How was she between the attacks, and what do this attack's results share with the first?

guidance.zh-CN: 问清上次发作和之后的情况，查看这次的淀粉酶、血钙和 CT，然后在会诊板上决定下一步。
guidance.en: Ask about the earlier attack and how she has been since, read this admission's amylase, calcium and CT, then decide the next step on the case board.

hint.zh-CN: 这份激素报告到底测的是什么？在决定治疗之前，诊断要靠什么确立？影像又能回答什么问题？
hint.en: What exactly did that hormone report measure? Before treatment is decided, what establishes the diagnosis — and what question can imaging answer?

guidance.zh-CN: 查看激素结果和颈部影像，在会诊板上定下方案，然后付诸行动。
guidance.en: Read the hormone result and the neck imaging, set the plan on the case board, then act on it.

hint.zh-CN: 她现在的感觉和最新的血钙说明了什么？什么情况才需要静脉补钙？怎样确认已经治愈？
hint.en: What do her symptoms and her latest calcium tell you — when does calcium need to go into a vein — and how will you know she is cured?

guidance.zh-CN: 问她现在的感觉，查看病理和最新的血钙、激素结果，在会诊板上定下计划，最后查看记录的结局。
guidance.en: Ask how she feels, read the histology and her latest calcium and hormone results, set the plan on the case board, and finally read the recorded outcome.

prompt.zh-CN: 她上腹持续胀痛 1 天，伴恶心。查体左上腹及脐周压痛、局部轻度肌紧张；淀粉酶 1139 U/L；CT 报告为胰腺炎。她的生命体征和病情严重程度没有记录。哪一个方案最适合她最初几天的处理？
prompt.en: She has had a day of constant upper abdominal pain with nausea. Her abdomen is tender in the left upper quadrant and around the umbilicus with mild guarding; amylase 1139 U/L; the CT report reads pancreatitis. Her vital signs and severity are not recorded. Which plan fits her first days of care?

need.zh-CN: 先问清这次腹痛，给她做腹部检查，并查看本次住院的淀粉酶和 CT 报告。
need.en: First take the history of the pain, examine her abdomen, and read this admission's amylase and CT report.

text.zh-CN: 乳酸钠林格液目标导向适度补液、充分镇痛，能耐受就开始低脂饮食；不预防性使用抗菌药物
text.en: Lactated Ringer's at a moderate, goal-directed rate, analgesia, and a low-fat diet once she can manage it; no prophylactic antibiotic

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。ACG 2024 指南建议用乳酸钠林格液适度补液——1.5 mL/(kg·h)，仅在低血容量时追加 10 mL/kg——并按反应反复评估；轻症在 24–48 小时内开始低脂经口饮食；不预防性使用抗菌药物。她的生命体征和严重程度没有记录，所以补液速度按心率、血压和尿量调整，而不是给一个固定的量。
feedback.en: Correct. ACG 2024 suggests lactated Ringer's at a moderately aggressive rate — 1.5 mL/kg/h, with a 10 mL/kg bolus only for hypovolaemia — reassessed against her response, a low-fat oral diet within 24–48 hours in mild disease, and no prophylactic antibiotics. Her vital signs and severity are not recorded, so the rate is titrated to her pulse, blood pressure and urine output rather than to a fixed volume.

text.zh-CN: 禁食到淀粉酶恢复正常，静脉补液、镇痛，同时预防性使用碳青霉烯类，防止坏死组织感染
text.en: Nil by mouth until the amylase is back to normal, with IV fluids and analgesia, and a prophylactic carbapenem to prevent infection of the necrosis

feedback.zh-CN: 这是旧做法。ACG 2024 指南建议轻症急性胰腺炎在 24–48 小时内开始低脂经口饮食，而不是禁食到酶学恢复；即使是重症也不建议预防性使用抗菌药物，因为没有证实的获益，反而有风险。报告中的处置正包括禁食和抗菌药物——那是记录的事实，不是今天的标准。
feedback.en: Historical, not current. ACG 2024 recommends a low-fat oral diet within 24–48 hours in mild acute pancreatitis rather than fasting until the enzymes settle, and advises against prophylactic antibiotics even in severe disease, for want of benefit and because of their risks. The report's own care included fasting and antibiotics — a fact of the record, not today's standard.

text.zh-CN: 大量快速补液：林格液 20 mL/kg 快速输注，此后第一天不论反应如何都按 3 mL/(kg·h) 输注，并镇痛
text.en: Aggressive resuscitation: a 20 mL/kg bolus of Ringer's, then 3 mL/kg/h for the first day whatever her response, with analgesia

feedback.zh-CN: 有害。WATERFALL 试验（NEJM 2022）中正是这一方案，比适度补液导致更多液体过负荷，却没有改善结局，试验因此提前终止；ACG 2024 指南现在建议适度、目标导向的补液。固定的大剂量补液不看她的实际反应。
feedback.en: Harmful. In the WATERFALL trial (NEJM 2022) exactly this regimen caused more fluid overload than moderate resuscitation without better outcomes, and the trial was stopped early; ACG 2024 now suggests moderate, goal-directed fluids. A fixed high volume ignores how she actually responds.

text.zh-CN: 24 小时内急诊 ERCP 清理胆管，同时静脉补液、镇痛，ERCP 做完以后再开始进食
text.en: Urgent ERCP within 24 hours to clear the bile duct, with IV fluids and analgesia, and food only once the ERCP is done

feedback.zh-CN: 没有指征。ACG 2024 指南指出，没有胆管炎的急性胰腺炎首选内科治疗，而不是早期 ERCP。这里没有任何指向胆管的记录——墨菲征阴性，也没有黄疸、胆红素或胆管表现的记录——而 ERCP 本身可引起胰腺炎、出血和穿孔。
feedback.en: Not indicated. ACG 2024 prefers medical therapy to early ERCP in acute pancreatitis without cholangitis. Nothing recorded here points to the bile duct — Murphy's sign is negative and no jaundice, bilirubin or duct finding is recorded — and ERCP can itself cause pancreatitis, bleeding and perforation.

prompt.zh-CN: 同一次住院：她的血钙 2.76 mmol/L（白蛋白没有记录），CT 还见左肾结石。你怎么看这个血钙？准备怎么处理？
prompt.en: The same admission: her calcium is 2.76 mmol/L (no albumin recorded), and the CT also shows a stone in the left kidney. How do you read the calcium, and what will you do about it?

need.zh-CN: 先查看本次住院的血钙和 CT 报告。
need.en: First read this admission's calcium and CT report.

text.zh-CN: 发作期血钙通常会降，此时升高不寻常；又有肾结石，应复查白蛋白校正钙并同步测 PTH
text.en: Unusual in an attack, which tends to lower it: with a kidney stone, repeat an albumin-adjusted calcium with a paired PTH, now or soon after discharge

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。胰腺炎发作通常使血钙下降，2.76 mmol/L 是一个信号，合并肾结石更提示存在高钙状态。IAP/APA 2013 指南把血钙列入每位患者的病因筛查；NICE NG132（2019）要求白蛋白校正钙 ≥ 2.6 mmol/L 时复查，并同步测 PTH 和校正钙；她的白蛋白没有记录。她第一次出院后是否做过这些，本病例没有记录。
feedback.en: Correct. An attack of pancreatitis usually lowers the calcium, so 2.76 mmol/L is a signal, and with a renal stone it points to a hypercalcaemic state. IAP/APA 2013 puts calcium in every patient's aetiology screen, and NICE NG132 (2019) repeats an albumin-adjusted calcium of 2.6 mmol/L or above and measures PTH with a paired adjusted calcium; her albumin is not recorded. Whether this was done after her first discharge is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 呕吐引起的血液浓缩：补液后自然会降下来，等她能吃东西了就不必再查血钙
text.en: Haemoconcentration from the vomiting: it will settle with the IV fluids, so no further calcium test is needed once she is eating again

feedback.zh-CN: 这是不安全的假设。脱水确实可使总钙略升，但不测白蛋白、不复查就无法判断；而胰腺炎发作通常使血钙下降而不是升高。NICE NG132（2019）要求复查并同步测 PTH，而不是简单安慰；这里漏掉的病因可能带来下一次发作。
feedback.en: Unsafe assumption. Dehydration can nudge a total calcium up, but you cannot know that without an albumin and a repeat, and an attack of pancreatitis normally pulls calcium down, not up. NICE NG132 (2019) asks for the repeat and a paired PTH rather than reassurance; a cause missed here can bring the next attack.

text.zh-CN: 这是胰腺炎本身造成的：发炎的胰腺把钙释放到血液里，不需要另外检查，病情好转后自然会降下来
text.en: Part of the pancreatitis itself: the inflamed gland releases its calcium into the blood, so it needs no separate test and will fall again as she recovers

feedback.zh-CN: 生理机制错了。急性胰腺炎时，钙在发炎组织的脂肪坏死处被结合，血钙下降——低钙是病情严重的标志之一——所以血钙升高需要单独解释。IAP/APA 2013 指南把血钙列入每位患者的病因筛查。
feedback.en: Wrong physiology. In acute pancreatitis calcium is bound up in the fat necrosis of the inflamed tissue and the blood level falls — a low calcium is a marker of severity — so a high value needs its own explanation. IAP/APA 2013 includes calcium in every patient's aetiology screen.

text.zh-CN: 肾结石可以解释血钙升高：转泌尿外科处理结石，结石取出以后血钙自然会恢复正常
text.en: The kidney stone explains it: refer her to urology to clear the stone, and the calcium will settle once the stone has gone

feedback.zh-CN: 因果颠倒了。肾结石是高血钙（及随之而来的高尿钙）的后果，而不是原因；取出结石并不能去除病因。血钙应复查并同步测 PTH（NICE NG132，2019），而结石本身就属于靶器官受累。
feedback.en: Backwards. Kidney stones are a consequence of a high calcium (and of the high urine calcium that goes with it), not its cause; removing a stone leaves the cause untouched. The calcium needs a repeat with a paired PTH (NICE NG132, 2019), and the stone itself counts as end-organ disease.

text.zh-CN: 住院期间立即静脉用唑来膦酸把血钙降下来，只有胰腺炎再发时才需要复查血钙
text.en: Lower it at once with IV zoledronic acid while she is in hospital, and recheck the calcium only if the pancreatitis comes back

feedback.zh-CN: 只处理了数字，没有处理病因。双膦酸盐用于严重或有症状的高钙血症；在这个水平，治疗胰腺炎的补液已经足够，同时应同步测 PTH 查找病因（NICE NG132，2019）；现在用药反而会干扰你需要的复查结果。
feedback.en: Treats a number, not the cause. A bisphosphonate is for severe or symptomatic hypercalcaemia; at this level the fluids she is already getting for the pancreatitis are enough while the cause is sought with a paired PTH (NICE NG132, 2019), and giving it now would blur the very repeat you need.

prompt.zh-CN: 第一次发作约 20 个月后，她又突然上腹胀痛入院：淀粉酶 1055.9 U/L，血钙 2.87 mmol/L，CT 仍见胰腺炎和肾结石。两次发作之间她一直很好——没有骨痛和腰背酸痛，也没有多尿多饮。第一次发作时血钙为 2.76 mmol/L。要查清病因，下一步怎么做？
prompt.en: About 20 months after the first attack she is back with sudden upper abdominal pain: amylase 1055.9 U/L, calcium 2.87 mmol/L, and the CT shows pancreatitis again with renal stone(s) still seen. Between the attacks she was well — no bone or back ache, no polyuria or polydipsia. At the first attack her calcium was 2.76 mmol/L. What is the next step to establish the cause?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 2，再问清上次发作和之后的情况，并查看这次住院的淀粉酶、血钙和 CT。
need.en: First answer decision 2, then ask about the earlier attack and how she has been since, and read this admission's amylase, calcium and CT.

text.zh-CN: 先用血液检查确立病因：同步测 PTH 和白蛋白校正钙，并查肌酐、维生素 D、尿钙；之后再定位
text.en: Prove it in the blood first: PTH with a paired albumin-adjusted calcium, plus creatinine, vitamin D and urine calcium; localising scans after that

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。原发性甲状旁腺功能亢进症靠生化确诊——血钙升高，同时 PTH 升高或与血钙不相称地正常，两者同步测定（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）——肌酐、维生素 D 和尿钙用于完善评估。之后的影像只是告诉外科医生去哪里找。
feedback.en: Correct. Primary hyperparathyroidism is diagnosed biochemically — a raised calcium with a raised or inappropriately normal PTH, measured together (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019) — and creatinine, vitamin D and urine calcium complete the assessment. Scans then only tell the surgeon where to look.

text.zh-CN: 先找病灶：马上做颈部超声和甲氧基异丁基异腈（MIBI）显像，阳性就能确诊，阴性就能排除
text.en: Find the gland first: neck ultrasound and a sestamibi scan straight away, since a positive scan makes the diagnosis and a negative one rules it out

feedback.zh-CN: 顺序错了。超声和 MIBI 显像只用于定位，既不能确诊也不能排除（第五届国际研讨会，2022）；扫描阴性并不能排除本病。先做影像还可能把偶然发现的甲状腺结节当成目标。
feedback.en: Wrong order. Ultrasound and sestamibi only localise; they can neither make nor exclude the diagnosis (Fifth International Workshop 2022), and a negative scan does not rule the disease out. Scanning first also risks chasing an incidental thyroid nodule.

text.zh-CN: 按特发性复发性胰腺炎处理：等这次发作缓解后做 ERCP 加胆管括约肌切开，处理影像上看不到的微小结石
text.en: Call it idiopathic recurrent pancreatitis: ERCP with biliary sphincterotomy once this attack settles, for hidden microlithiasis

feedback.zh-CN: 过早且有风险。血钙 2.87 mmol/L 伴肾结石还没有解释，她的胰腺炎不能称为特发性；ACG 2024 指南在没有胆管炎时首选内科治疗而不是 ERCP，括约肌切开本身还可能引起胰腺炎、出血和穿孔。
feedback.en: Premature and risky. Her pancreatitis is not idiopathic while a calcium of 2.87 mmol/L with renal stones is unexplained; ACG 2024 prefers medical therapy to ERCP when there is no cholangitis, and sphincterotomy carries its own risk of pancreatitis, bleeding and perforation.

text.zh-CN: 按影像漏掉的小胆结石考虑，择期切除胆囊，预防第三次发作
text.en: Assume small gallstones the scans have missed, and book an elective cholecystectomy to prevent a third attack

feedback.zh-CN: 没有依据。没有任何胆结石的记录，而一个有记录的代谢线索正等着确认；按假定的胆源性病因手术，真正的病因仍然留着。IAP/APA 2013 指南要在包括血钙在内的病因筛查完成之后，才把胰腺炎称为特发性。
feedback.en: Unsupported. No gallstones are documented, and a documented metabolic clue is waiting to be confirmed; operating on a presumed biliary cause leaves the real one in place. IAP/APA 2013 calls a pancreatitis idiopathic only after the aetiology screen, calcium included, is complete.

text.zh-CN: 等她恢复进食后再复查血钙，只有那时仍高于 3.0 mmol/L 才需要进一步检查
text.en: Recheck the calcium once she is eating again, and investigate further only if it is still above 3.0 mmol/L then

feedback.zh-CN: 门槛定得太高。NICE NG132（2019）规定白蛋白校正钙两次 ≥ 2.6 mmol/L 就应测 PTH——她两次未校正的血钙为 2.76 和 2.87 mmol/L，白蛋白没有记录——并没有 3.0 mmol/L 才检查的门槛；有肾结石、又已两次发作，再等只会增加风险。
feedback.en: Too high a bar. NICE NG132 (2019) measures PTH once the albumin-adjusted calcium has been 2.6 mmol/L or above twice — her unadjusted values are 2.76 and 2.87 mmol/L, and her albumin is not recorded — and sets no 3.0 mmol/L threshold for looking; with kidney stones and two attacks, waiting only adds risk.

prompt.zh-CN: 激素结果为 31 pmol/L，项目标为“甲状腺素”；参考区间、TSH 和同步的血钙都没有记录。颈部超声和 CT 显示左侧甲状腺下极后方有一个病灶。你的方案是什么？
prompt.en: The hormone result reads 31 pmol/L under the label 'thyroxine'; no reference interval, TSH or paired calcium is recorded. Neck ultrasound and CT show a lesion behind the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe. What is your plan?

need.zh-CN: 先完成决策 3，再查看这次的激素结果和随后的影像报告。
need.en: First answer decision 3, then read this admission's hormone result and the imaging report that follows it.

text.zh-CN: 向检验科核实 31 pmol/L 测的是什么，复查完整 PTH 并同步测血钙；PTH 升高再转诊有经验的甲状旁腺外科医生
text.en: Check with the laboratory what the 31 pmol/L measured and repeat an intact PTH with a paired calcium; if it is raised, refer her to an experienced parathyroid surgeon

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。手术必须以生化诊断为前提——血钙升高，同时 PTH 升高或与血钙不相称地正常，两者同步测定（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）——而这里唯一的激素结果标着“甲状腺素”。一个电话或一份标本就能澄清；之后，有肾结石和反复胰腺炎，应由有经验的甲状旁腺外科医生手术（NICE NG132，2019；AAES 2016）。
feedback.en: Correct. The operation rests on a biochemical diagnosis — a raised calcium with a raised or inappropriately normal PTH, measured together (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019) — and the only hormone value here carries a thyroxine label. One call or one sample settles it; then, with kidney stones and recurrent pancreatitis, surgery by an experienced parathyroid surgeon is indicated (NICE NG132, 2019; AAES 2016).

text.zh-CN: 把 31 pmol/L 当作 PTH，马上安排颈部单侧手术，因为两种影像都显示同一个病灶，诊断已经明确
text.en: Take the 31 pmol/L as her PTH and list her for a focused neck operation now, because two imaging tests that show the same lesion behind the thyroid settle the diagnosis

feedback.zh-CN: 还不行。影像只能定位，不能确诊（第五届国际研讨会，2022），而唯一的激素结果标着“甲状腺素”。如果 PTH 实际偏低，NICE NG132（2019）要求寻找包括恶性肿瘤在内的其他病因，这时做颈部手术就是在处理错误的问题。
feedback.en: Not yet. Imaging only localises; it cannot make the diagnosis (Fifth International Workshop 2022), and the one hormone value is labelled thyroxine. If the PTH proved low, NICE NG132 (2019) sends you looking for another cause, including malignancy, and a neck operation would treat the wrong problem.

text.zh-CN: 把 31 pmol/L 理解为游离甲状腺素升高：先治疗甲亢，它可以解释高血钙，颈部手术之前再复查血钙
text.en: Read the 31 pmol/L as a high free thyroxine: treat the hyperthyroidism, which accounts for the calcium, and recheck the calcium before any neck surgery

feedback.zh-CN: 解读不安全。没有参考区间和 TSH，这个甲状腺素数值几乎无法解释，而这两者都没有记录；甲亢也解释不了甲状腺后方的病灶，更不能因此忽视肾结石。应先澄清项目名称，并同步测 PTH 和血钙（NICE NG132，2019）。
feedback.en: Unsafe reading. A thyroxine value means little without its reference interval and a TSH, neither recorded, and hyperthyroidism would not explain the lesion behind the thyroid or justify ignoring the stones. Resolve the label and measure the PTH with a paired calcium (NICE NG132, 2019).

text.zh-CN: 先在超声引导下细针穿刺这个病灶，证实是甲状旁腺组织之后，再请外科医生考虑手术
text.en: Biopsy the lesion with a fine needle under ultrasound first, to prove it is parathyroid tissue before any surgeon is asked to operate on it

feedback.zh-CN: 这不是诊断步骤。诊断靠生化（第五届国际研讨会，2022）；对疑似甲状旁腺病灶穿刺可能出血、造成粘连并使甲状旁腺组织种植，细胞学也常难以区分甲状旁腺与甲状腺组织，只用于少数诊断不清的病例。
feedback.en: Not a diagnostic step. The diagnosis is biochemical (Fifth International Workshop 2022), and needle biopsy of a suspected parathyroid lesion risks bleeding, scarring and seeding of parathyroid tissue, with cytology that often cannot tell parathyroid from thyroid; it is kept for selected, unclear cases.

text.zh-CN: 先用西那卡塞并观察：血钙还不到 3.0 mmol/L，手术可以缓一缓，等以后血钙升高、结石增大或者出现第三次发作时再说
text.en: Start cinacalcet and watch: with a calcium below 3.0 mmol/L surgery can wait until the calcium rises, the stones grow or a third attack comes

feedback.zh-CN: 不对。肾结石加两次胰腺炎属于有症状的疾病，不论血钙多少都有手术指征（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）。西那卡塞能降钙却不能治愈，只用于不能或不愿手术的患者（AAES 2016 指出手术是唯一的根治手段）。
feedback.en: No. Kidney stones and two attacks of pancreatitis make this symptomatic disease, for which surgery is indicated whatever the calcium (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019). Cinacalcet lowers the calcium but cures nothing and is for people who cannot or will not have surgery (AAES 2016 calls surgery the only definitive treatment).

prompt.zh-CN: 病理：甲状旁腺腺瘤，约 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm。术后 PTH 3.8 pmol/L，血钙 2.18 mmol/L（参考区间没有记录，报告称两者都在正常范围）。她说胳膊和腿发麻，没有抽搐。她的计划应包括哪些？（多选）
prompt.en: Histology: parathyroid adenoma, about 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm. After the operation her PTH is 3.8 pmol/L and her calcium 2.18 mmol/L (no reference intervals recorded; the report calls both normal). She says her arms and legs feel numb, and she has had no spasms. What should her plan include? (Select all that apply.)

need.zh-CN: 先查看最新的病理、血钙和激素结果，并问她现在的感觉、有没有抽搐。
need.en: First read the latest histology, calcium and hormone results, and ask how she feels now and whether she has had any spasms.

text.zh-CN: 复查白蛋白校正钙或离子钙及血镁，并检查面神经叩击征（Chvostek 征）和束臂加压征（Trousseau 征）
text.en: Recheck an albumin-adjusted or ionised calcium with magnesium, and look for Chvostek's and Trousseau's signs

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。术后症状要对照校正钙或离子钙来判断，英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）也是按校正钙分级——本病例没有记录；血镁低会妨碍 PTH 分泌，需要一并检查；Chvostek 征和 Trousseau 征能显示单靠麻木看不出的神经肌肉兴奋性增高。
feedback.en: Include. Symptoms after parathyroid surgery are judged against an adjusted or ionised calcium, as the Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance (2016) grades them — none is recorded here; a low magnesium impairs PTH secretion and is checked alongside; Chvostek's and Trousseau's signs show neuromuscular irritability that the numbness alone does not.

text.zh-CN: 按严重程度处理：症状轻时口服钙剂；校正钙低于 1.9 mmol/L，或钙低于参考区间且有症状时，静脉补葡萄糖酸钙
text.en: Treat by severity: oral calcium for mild symptoms; IV calcium gluconate for an adjusted calcium below 1.9 mmol/L, or for symptoms with a calcium below the reference range

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）把校正钙低于 1.9 mmol/L、或钙低于参考区间且有症状列为急症：10% 葡萄糖酸钙 10–20 mL 加入 5% 葡萄糖 50–100 mL，10 分钟内推注，心电监护下，之后持续滴注。症状轻者口服补钙并复查血钙。
feedback.en: Include. The Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance (2016) treats an adjusted calcium below 1.9 mmol/L, or symptoms with a calcium below the reference range, as an emergency: 10–20 mL of 10 % calcium gluconate in 50–100 mL of 5 % glucose over 10 minutes with ECG monitoring, then an infusion. Milder symptoms are managed by mouth with a repeat calcium.

text.zh-CN: 术后 3–6 个月复查白蛋白校正钙以确认治愈，并继续随访肾结石
text.en: Recheck the albumin-adjusted calcium 3–6 months after the operation to confirm cure, and keep following her kidney stones

feedback.zh-CN: 应选。AAES 2016 把治愈定义为血钙正常超过 6 个月；NICE NG132（2019）建议术后 3–6 个月测白蛋白校正钙以确认手术成功。她的肾结石在手术前就已存在，需要单独随访。
feedback.en: Include. AAES 2016 defines cure as a normal calcium for more than 6 months, and NICE NG132 (2019) checks the albumin-adjusted calcium 3–6 months after surgery to confirm success. Her stones existed before the operation and need their own follow-up.

text.zh-CN: 立即开始持续静脉滴注葡萄糖酸钙，并让她一直住院，直到麻木完全消失
text.en: Start a continuous IV calcium gluconate infusion now and keep her in hospital until the numbness has gone

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。她的血钙 2.18 mmol/L，报告称在正常范围，也没有抽搐：达不到英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）静脉补钙的标准。不复查校正钙就持续静滴，可能矫枉过正造成高钙，还白白延长住院。
feedback.en: Exclude. Her calcium is 2.18 mmol/L, which the report calls normal, and she has no spasms: nothing here meets the Society for Endocrinology (2016) thresholds for IV calcium. An infusion without a repeat adjusted calcium risks overshooting into hypercalcaemia and keeps her in hospital for no gain.

text.zh-CN: 开始终身服用骨化三醇，因为颈部手术后这么快出现麻木，说明已经是永久性甲状旁腺功能减退
text.en: Start calcitriol for life, because numbness this soon after neck surgery means permanent hypoparathyroidism

feedback.zh-CN: 不选。术后最初几天血钙下降得快，被抑制的其余甲状旁腺还在恢复，短暂症状是可以预料的；她的 PTH 3.8 pmol/L，报告称在正常范围，没有任何永久性甲旁减的证据。结局要在几个月后用血钙判断（NICE NG132，2019）。
feedback.en: Exclude. In the first days the calcium falls quickly while the suppressed remaining glands recover, so transient symptoms are expected; her PTH is 3.8 pmol/L, which the report calls normal, and nothing points to permanent hypoparathyroidism. The outcome is judged with a calcium months later (NICE NG132, 2019).

text.zh-CN: 采集第一次发作的病史：腹痛及持续时间、呕吐、饮酒、既往胆结石和平时用药
text.en: Took the history of the first attack: the pain and how long it had lasted, the vomiting, alcohol, known gallstones and regular medicines

text.zh-CN: 再次入院时询问上次发作、两次之间的身体情况、停药后的血压，以及血钙是否随访过
text.en: At the readmission, asked about the earlier attack, her health in between, her blood pressure off tablets and whether the calcium had been followed up

text.zh-CN: 第一次入院时检查腹部（压痛和肌紧张、反跳痛、墨菲征）并触诊颈部
text.en: At the first admission, examined the abdomen (tenderness and guarding, rebound, Murphy's sign) and palpated the neck

text.zh-CN: 查看第一次发作的淀粉酶、血钙和 CT，并送检病因筛查：胆囊超声、甘油三酯和肝功能
text.en: Read the first attack's amylase, calcium and CT, and sent the cause screen: gallbladder ultrasound, triglycerides and liver tests

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择现行的早期处理方案，并在发作期实际给予目标导向的适度林格液补液和早期经口进食
text.en: Chose the current plan for the first days at the first attempt, and during the attack actually gave moderate goal-directed Ringer's and early oral feeding

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即认识到发作期血钙升高合并肾结石不寻常，需要复查并同步测 PTH
text.en: Recognised at the first attempt that a raised calcium during an attack, with a kidney stone, is unusual and needs a repeat with a paired PTH

text.zh-CN: 第一次住院出院前就追查了升高的血钙：送检 PTH，或安排出院后复查血钙并同步测 PTH
text.en: Pursued the raised calcium before she left the first admission: sent a PTH, or arranged a calcium recheck with a paired PTH after discharge

text.zh-CN: 再次发作时首次作答即把生化诊断（同步测 PTH 与血钙）放在任何定位影像之前
text.en: At the second attack, put the biochemical diagnosis (PTH with a paired calcium) before any localisation scan at the first attempt

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即决定术前先澄清标为“甲状腺素”的结果，实际向检验科核实之后才转诊外科
text.en: Chose at the first attempt to resolve the thyroxine-labelled result before surgery, and actually verified it with the laboratory before referring her to the surgeon

text.zh-CN: 没有预防性使用抗菌药物、强制禁食、大量快速补液、急诊 ERCP、细针穿刺、以西那卡塞代替手术或持续静脉补钙
text.en: Gave no prophylactic antibiotic, enforced fasting, aggressive fluids, urgent ERCP, needle biopsy, cinacalcet in place of surgery or continuous IV calcium

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即正确制订术后计划，并安排确认治愈的随访
text.en: Set the post-operative plan correctly at the first attempt and arranged the follow-up that confirms cure

text.zh-CN: 向她解释发现的病因、手术的理由和麻木的含义，并确认她已理解
text.en: Explained to her the cause that was found, the reason for the operation and what the numbness means, and checked her understanding

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 表现良好（Calgary–Cambridge：开始、采集信息、解释与计划、结束）：第一次住院时用通俗语言解释胰腺炎，说明即使腹痛好了，血钙结果也必须随访，漏掉它可能再发作；正面回应她“怕再犯”的担心，不作虚假保证。再次入院时解释两次发作和血钙指向颈部一个分泌过多的腺体，诊断先靠抽血，扫描只是告诉外科医生它在哪里；说明有一项结果名称不清楚，需要和检验科核实；讲清手术做什么、为什么建议手术，并取得同意。术后解释麻木可能与血钙下降过快有关、要查什么、出现哪些情况要马上告诉医护（抽筋、嘴唇周围发麻），以及几个月后复查血钙确认治愈。用复述确认理解，不编造本病例没有记录的结果。
judgeGuidance.en: Good performance (Calgary–Cambridge: initiating, gathering, explaining and planning, closing): at the first admission, explains pancreatitis in plain words and why a blood calcium result must be followed up even once the pain has gone — missing it could mean another attack — and answers her fear that it will come back without false reassurance. At the readmission, explains that the two attacks and the calcium point to an overactive gland in the neck, that the diagnosis is made by a blood test first and a scan only shows the surgeon where it is, and that one result has an unclear label that must be checked with the laboratory; explains what the operation involves and why it is offered, and obtains consent. After the operation, explains that numbness can come from the calcium falling quickly, what will be checked, what to report at once (cramps, tingling around the mouth), and the calcium check months later that confirms cure. Checks understanding by teach-back and invents no result the case does not record.

knowledge.zh-CN: 病房护士。入院交班（ISBAR）：58岁女性，上腹持续胀痛伴恶心、呕吐 1 天，刚收入病房。病房里有床旁监护仪，治疗车上有留置针、输液和药品，护士站有病历终端；血标本送检验科，CT 和超声在放射科。复述并执行护理范围内的医嘱（留置针、补液、给药、饮食），只报告已经出来的结果。她的生命体征、体重和出入量都没有记录：被问到时如实说明，不给任何数字；不解读结果，也不说诊断。
knowledge.en: Ward nurse. Admission handover (ISBAR): a 58-year-old woman with a day of constant upper abdominal pain, nausea and vomiting, just admitted to the ward. On the ward: bedside monitors, cannulas, infusion fluids and drugs on the treatment cart, and a records terminal at the nurses' station; blood samples go to the laboratory, and CT and ultrasound are in radiology. Reads back and carries out nursing-scope orders (cannula, fluids, medicines, diet) and reports only results that are back. Her vital signs, weight and fluid balance are not recorded: asked for them, she says so plainly and never gives a number; she does not interpret results or name a diagnosis.

name.zh-CN: 杜医生（消化内科主治医师）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教（PEARLS），只就学员已经掌握的信息提问，例如：“哪两项依据已经足以诊断这次发作？CT 是不是必需的？”“急性发作通常会把血钙往哪个方向推？”“在说‘特发性’之前，你已经排除了什么？”“手术之前，血里必须证实什么？扫描永远回答不了什么？”“一项结果的名称可能写错时，你在行动之前要做什么？”“颈部手术后发麻：查什么？什么阈值才需要静脉补钙？”可讲解 ACG 2024 和 IAP/APA 2013 关于最初几天处理和病因筛查的要点、NICE NG132（2019）和第五届国际研讨会（2022）关于生化诊断的要点、AAES 2016 关于手术与治愈的定义，以及英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）关于低钙血症的处理；学员读过相应记录后，可对照报告中的处置（禁食和抗菌药物；颈部病灶在第二次发作后才发现，第一次出院后是否追查血钙没有记录）与现行做法。学员作答之前不说出诊断或任何决策的答案，也不补充本病例没有的信息：生命体征、两次发作的严重程度、白蛋白或离子钙、胆囊影像、甘油三酯、脂肪酶、激素结果的参考区间、手术细节和随访时长都没有记录。
knowledge.en: Socratic preceptor (PEARLS) who asks only about what the learner already has, e.g. 'Which two findings already make the diagnosis of this attack — did you need the CT for it?', 'Which way would you expect an acute attack to push the calcium?', 'Before you call it idiopathic, what have you excluded?', 'Before an operation, what has to be proved in the blood, and what can a scan never tell you?', 'If a result may carry the wrong name, what do you do before acting on it?', 'Numbness after neck surgery: what do you check, and at what threshold does calcium go into a vein?'. May explain ACG 2024 and IAP/APA 2013 on the first days of care and the aetiology screen, NICE NG132 (2019) and the Fifth International Workshop (2022) on the biochemical diagnosis, AAES 2016 on surgery and the definition of cure, and the Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance (2016) on hypocalcaemia — and, once the learner has read the records, contrast the reported care (fasting and antibiotics; the neck lesion found only after the second attack, with no record of whether the calcium was pursued after the first discharge) with current practice. Never states the diagnosis or a decision's answer before the learner commits, and adds nothing the case lacks: vital signs, the severity of either attack, albumin or ionised calcium, gallbladder imaging, triglycerides, lipase, the hormone value's reference interval, the operative details and the length of follow-up are not recorded.

knowledge.zh-CN: 内分泌科会诊医生，被请会诊时到场。只解读学员已经读过的血钙、激素和影像记录：生化诊断的标准（血钙升高，同时 PTH 升高或与血钙不相称地正常，两者同步测定）；为什么检验项目名称有疑问时必须先澄清；一个甲状腺素数值需要哪些配套信息（TSH 和参考区间）；为什么 PTH 偏低就要找别的病因；为什么影像只能定位、不能诊断；有症状的病例手术指征；以及手术成功后血钙为何会快速下降。不报告学员没有读过的结果，不把 31 pmol/L 擅自改称 PTH，也不编造参考区间、白蛋白、维生素 D、尿钙或手术所见——这些都没有记录。
knowledge.en: Endocrinologist who comes when consulted. Interprets only the calcium, hormone and imaging records the learner has read: the biochemical criteria (a raised calcium with a raised or inappropriately normal PTH, measured together); why a doubtful analyte name must be settled first; what a thyroxine value would need beside it (a TSH and reference intervals); why a low PTH sends you looking for another cause; why imaging localises but never diagnoses; the surgical indication in symptomatic disease; and why the calcium falls quickly after a successful operation. Never reports a result the learner has not read, never relabels the 31 pmol/L value as a PTH on their own authority, and never invents a reference interval, albumin, vitamin D, urine calcium or operative finding — none is recorded.

title.zh-CN: 复盘：两次急性胰腺炎背后升高的血钙
title.en: Debrief: the raised calcium behind two attacks of pancreatitis

conclusion.zh-CN: 58岁女性约 20 个月内两次急性胰腺炎：第一次上腹持续胀痛伴恶心、呕吐 1 天，淀粉酶 1139 U/L，CT 示胰腺炎及左肾结石，血钙 2.76 mmol/L；第二次突然起病，淀粉酶 1055.9 U/L，血钙 2.87 mmol/L，CT 仍见胰腺炎和肾结石。两次之间她没有症状，未服降压药时血压正常。颈部超声及 CT 示左甲状腺下极后方病灶；切除约 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm，病理为甲状旁腺腺瘤。唯一的术前激素结果 31 pmol/L 标为“甲状腺素”；术后 PTH 3.8 pmol/L、血钙 2.18 mmol/L 并维持正常，曾短暂四肢麻木、无抽搐、自行缓解，随访未诉不适。诊断：甲状旁腺腺瘤所致原发性甲旁亢，以反复急性胰腺炎为表现。现行做法：第一次发作就追查血钙，先用 PTH 确诊，再定位和手术。
conclusion.en: A 58-year-old woman had two attacks of acute pancreatitis about 20 months apart: first a day of constant upper abdominal pain and vomiting (amylase 1139 U/L; CT pancreatitis and a left kidney stone; calcium 2.76 mmol/L), then a sudden recurrence (amylase 1055.9 U/L; calcium 2.87 mmol/L; CT pancreatitis, renal stone(s) still seen). In between she was well, her blood pressure normal off tablets. Neck ultrasound/CT showed a lesion behind the lower pole of the left thyroid lobe; it was removed (about 2 × 1.5 × 1 cm): a parathyroid adenoma. The only pre-operative hormone value, 31 pmol/L, is labelled 'thyroxine'. After surgery the PTH was 3.8 pmol/L and the calcium 2.18 mmol/L, both staying normal; transient limb numbness without tetany settled by itself, and she was well at follow-up. Diagnosis: primary hyperparathyroidism (parathyroid adenoma) presenting as recurrent acute pancreatitis. Today: pursue the calcium at the first attack, prove PTH-dependence before any scan, then operate.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 典型腹痛加上 CT 改变已能诊断急性胰腺炎；接下来真正要做的是查清病因，因为病因留着，下一次发作就会来。
keyReasoning.en: Typical pain with CT changes already establishes acute pancreatitis; the work that matters next is the cause, because a cause left in place brings the next attack.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 急性发作通常使血钙下降，所以发作期 2.76 mmol/L 是信号；再加上左肾结石，指向的是高钙状态，而不是脱水。
keyReasoning.en: An attack of pancreatitis tends to lower the calcium, so 2.76 mmol/L during one is a signal; with a left kidney stone it points to a hypercalcaemic state rather than to dehydration.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 第二次发作时血钙 2.87 mmol/L、CT 仍见结石，甲旁亢成为首要怀疑——但要在血里证实，而不是在扫描上；胆石、饮酒和甘油三酯在本病例中都没有记录，仍需筛查。
keyReasoning.en: A second attack with calcium 2.87 mmol/L and stones still on CT makes hyperparathyroidism the leading suspect — to be proved in the blood, not on a scan; gallstones, alcohol and triglycerides are not recorded either way and still need screening.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 唯一的术前激素结果标着“甲状腺素”：在检验科确认或复查配对 PTH 之前，它不能作为手术的依据。
keyReasoning.en: The only pre-operative hormone value carries a thyroxine label: until the laboratory confirms it or a paired PTH is repeated, it cannot carry the decision to operate.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 腺瘤切除后 PTH（3.8 pmol/L）和血钙（2.18 mmol/L）下降并伴短暂麻木，是预料中的快速变化：需要有针对性地复查，而不是反射性静脉补钙；是否治愈要几个月后判断。
keyReasoning.en: After the adenoma is removed, the fall in PTH (3.8 pmol/L) and calcium (2.18 mmol/L) with transient numbness is the expected rapid shift: it calls for a measured check, not reflex IV calcium, and cure is judged months later.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 急性胰腺炎的最初几天（ACG 2024）：乳酸钠林格液适度、目标导向补液——1.5 mL/(kg·h)，仅在低血容量时追加 10 mL/kg；WATERFALL 试验（NEJM 2022）中 20 mL/kg 加 3 mL/(kg·h) 的方案带来更多液体过负荷却无获益而提前终止——轻症 24–48 小时内低脂经口饮食，不预防性使用抗菌药物，只在胆管炎时行早期 ERCP。过去与现在：报告中的处置包括禁食和抗菌药物。
teachingPoints.en: The first days of acute pancreatitis (ACG 2024): lactated Ringer's at a moderate, goal-directed rate — 1.5 mL/kg/h, with 10 mL/kg boluses only for hypovolaemia; the WATERFALL trial (NEJM 2022) stopped early when 20 mL/kg plus 3 mL/kg/h caused more fluid overload without benefit — a low-fat oral diet within 24–48 hours in mild disease, no prophylactic antibiotics, and early ERCP only with cholangitis. Then and now: the report's care included fasting and antibiotics.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 每一次首发都要查病因：饮酒和用药史、胆囊超声、肝功能、甘油三酯和血钙（IAP/APA 2013）。发作期血钙通常下降，升高就是危险信号；NICE NG132（2019）要求白蛋白校正钙 ≥ 2.6 mmol/L 时复查，并同步测 PTH。过去与现在：她第一次的 2.76 mmol/L 是否追查过没有记录，病因在第二次发作后才找到。
teachingPoints.en: Every first attack needs its cause sought: alcohol and drug history, gallbladder ultrasound, liver tests, triglycerides and calcium (IAP/APA 2013). Calcium usually falls in an attack, so a raised value is a red flag; NICE NG132 (2019) repeats an albumin-adjusted calcium of 2.6 mmol/L or above and measures PTH with a paired adjusted calcium. Then and now: whether her 2.76 mmol/L was pursued is not recorded; the cause was found after the second attack.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 原发性甲旁亢是生化诊断——血钙升高，同时 PTH 升高或与血钙不相称地正常（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）；PTH 偏低就要找别的病因。超声、CT 或 MIBI 只为外科医生定位，既不能确诊也不能排除。项目名称存疑的结果——这里标为“甲状腺素”的 31 pmol/L——要先与检验科核实或复查，才能用来做决定。
teachingPoints.en: Primary hyperparathyroidism is a biochemical diagnosis — a raised calcium with a raised or inappropriately normal PTH (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019); a low PTH sends you looking for another cause. Ultrasound, CT or sestamibi only localise the gland for the surgeon and can neither make nor exclude the diagnosis. A result whose analyte label is in doubt — here 31 pmol/L labelled 'thyroxine' — is resolved with the laboratory or repeated before it carries a decision.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 肾结石说明疾病有症状，反复胰腺炎更添分量：应转诊有经验的甲状旁腺外科医生（第五届国际研讨会 2022；NICE NG132，2019）。手术是唯一的根治手段（AAES 2016）；西那卡塞能降钙但不能治愈，只用于不能手术者；疑似甲状旁腺病灶的细针穿刺不是诊断步骤。
teachingPoints.en: Kidney stones make this symptomatic disease, and recurrent pancreatitis adds weight: refer to an experienced parathyroid surgeon (Fifth International Workshop 2022; NICE NG132, 2019). Surgery is the only definitive treatment (AAES 2016); cinacalcet lowers the calcium without curing and is for those who cannot have surgery; a needle biopsy of a suspected parathyroid lesion is not a diagnostic step.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 成功手术后血钙下降很快，可能出现麻木。应复查白蛋白校正钙或离子钙及血镁，检查 Chvostek 征和 Trousseau 征；英国内分泌学会急诊指南（2016）在校正钙低于 1.9 mmol/L、或钙低于参考区间且有症状时，给 10% 葡萄糖酸钙 10–20 mL 10 分钟内静推（心电监护下）。术后 3–6 个月复查校正钙确认手术成功（NICE NG132，2019；AAES 2016 把治愈定义为血钙正常超过 6 个月）。
teachingPoints.en: After a successful operation the calcium falls fast and numbness can follow. Check an albumin-adjusted or ionised calcium with magnesium and look for Chvostek's and Trousseau's signs; the Society for Endocrinology emergency guidance (2016) gives 10–20 mL of 10 % calcium gluconate over 10 minutes with ECG monitoring for an adjusted calcium below 1.9 mmol/L, or symptoms with a calcium below the reference range. Confirm success with an adjusted calcium 3–6 months after surgery (NICE NG132, 2019; AAES 2016 defines cure as normocalcaemia beyond 6 months).

boundaries.zh-CN: 单篇病例报告，本版依据 1.0.0 版提取的事实改写，尚未对照原文全文核对。它不能说明甲旁亢引起胰腺炎的频率，也不能证明更早手术就能避免第二次发作。生命体征、严重程度指标、白蛋白、离子钙、胆囊影像、甘油三酯、脂肪酶、参考区间、手术细节和随访时长都没有记录；决策、处置选项和评分是教学设计，不改变记录的病程。
boundaries.en: A single case report, re-authored here from the facts extracted for version 1.0.0 and not yet checked against the full article. It cannot show how often hyperparathyroidism causes pancreatitis, or that an earlier operation would have prevented the second attack. No vital signs, severity markers, albumin, ionised calcium, gallbladder imaging, triglycerides, lipase, reference intervals, operative details or length of follow-up are recorded; the decisions, intervention options and scoring are teaching design and do not change the recorded course.

unknowns.zh-CN: 两次发作的生命体征、器官功能和严重程度（器官衰竭、CT 分级），以及脂肪酶、肝功能、甘油三酯、血常规和肾功能。
unknowns.en: Vital signs, organ function and the severity of either attack (organ failure, CT grading); lipase, liver tests, triglycerides, blood count and renal function.

unknowns.zh-CN: 任何时间点的白蛋白和离子钙，因此无法计算白蛋白校正钙；各项结果的参考区间。

unknowns.zh-CN: 第一次出院后血钙 2.76 mmol/L 是否复查或追查过；胆囊影像、饮酒、用药、吸烟和家族史。
unknowns.en: Whether the calcium of 2.76 mmol/L was rechecked or investigated after the first discharge; gallbladder imaging, alcohol, medicines, smoking and family history.

unknowns.zh-CN: 术前 31 pmol/L 那项结果实际测的是什么（PTH 还是甲状腺素）、何时测定、配对的血钙是多少，以及 TSH。
unknowns.en: What the pre-operative 31 pmol/L value measured (PTH or thyroxine), when it was taken, with which calcium, and the TSH.

unknowns.zh-CN: 25-羟维生素 D、24 小时尿钙、骨密度，以及第二次 CT 上结石的侧别和数目。
unknowns.en: 25-hydroxyvitamin D, 24-hour urine calcium, bone density, and the side and number of the stones on the second CT.

unknowns.zh-CN: 手术方式、其余甲状旁腺、术中 PTH、手术距第二次入院的时间，以及术后 PTH 和血钙的测定时间与四肢麻木的先后。
unknowns.en: The operation (approach, other glands, intraoperative PTH), its timing relative to the second admission, and when the post-operative PTH and calcium were measured relative to the numbness.

unknowns.zh-CN: 禁食和抗菌药物治疗的具体药物、剂量、疗程和用于哪一次发作；随访时长和结石此后的情况。
unknowns.en: The agents, doses and duration of the fasting and antibiotic care and which attack they were given for; the length of follow-up and the later course of the stones.
